_comment: A hand-written Overpass-shaped extract for the ONE rule in
tools/mkpack.py that osm-asok.json cannot exercise: the fallback from
name:en to name. Every way in the real extract that lacks name:en has a
Thai name, so the ASCII-name branch is never taken there, and a branch
with no test is a branch that quietly rots.
Five ways, one for each case the indexer has to get right:
1  name:en and name       -> indexed as the name:en form
2  name only, ASCII       -> indexed as the name (the fallback)
3  name only, non-ASCII   -> dropped, and COUNTED in the header
4  no name at all         -> routable, never searchable
5  name:en, same as 1     -> one place with points from two ways
Coordinates are on a 0.001 degree grid near the Asok junction so the
numbers in tests/test_search.c are readable; nothing depends on where.
